title: WATCH: Travis Head Mocks Temba Bavuma With AI Generated Video Of Josh Hazlewood Dancing
key_facts: Australia batter Travis Head shared an AI-generated video on his official Instagram story mocking South Africa captain Temba Bavuma.
It came after Australia beat South Africa by 214 runs in the first Test at Kingsmead, Durban, giving Australia a 1-0 series lead.
In the clip Bavuma's smiling face turns to shock at the final scorecard, then an AI version of Josh Hazlewood in Australian Test whites dances in a nightclub.
Hazlewood took 6 for 49 in 16.5 overs as South Africa were bowled out for 206 chasing 421; opener Matt Renshaw hit two centuries.
The magazine calls it Bavuma's first defeat as South Africa's Test captain.
The magazine says thousands of reactions flooded X and Instagram.
quote_evidence: Travis Head took to Instagram to mock South Africa captain Temba Bavuma with a viral AI-generated video of Josh Hazlewood dancing after the Durban Test win.
The scene then morphs to a busy nightclub with an AI version of Hazlewood in Australian Test whites, busting rhythmic dance moves under a lone spotlight.
why_it_matters_hint: Banter between players using AI video after a heavy defeat; no consequence beyond fan reaction.
event_date: Not stated; after the first Test in Durban, article published 13 Oct 2026
notes: Full text read. The article contradicts itself on Bavuma's record (first defeat as captain, but 'near-yearlong unbeaten run since early 2023'), so the summary leaves that claim out. Match dates are not given.
